description: This file defines a React component for embedding and playing YouTube videos, including thumbnail handling, play controls, and link validation.

classes.name: YoutubeVideo
classes.description: A React component for displaying and playing YouTube videos with thumbnail support and link validation.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Updates component state based on new props, managing thumbnail resolution and playback state.

methods.name: getMaxResUrl
methods.description: Constructs URL for maximum resolution thumbnail based on video ID.

methods.name: getHQUrl
methods.description: Constructs URL for high quality thumbnail based on video ID.

methods.name: handleImageError
methods.description: Handles thumbnail image load errors, falling back to lower resolution.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Sets the component state to playing, displaying the embedded video.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the thumbnail or embedded video based on current state.

methods.name: isYoutubeLink
methods.description: Static method to validate if a link is a YouTube URL.
